question_text: A government scholarship fund of P180,000 is divided among three students in the ratio 2:3:4. What is the largest individual scholarship?

hint_ladder.title: Ilang Slice Lahat?
hint_ladder.text: I-add lang ang ratio numbers: 2+3+4 = 9. Imagine nine equal slices ng bibingka. Yung total parts ang foundation ng solution.

hint_ladder.title: Value ng Isang Slice
hint_ladder.text: Hatiin ang total fund (₱180,000) sa total slices (9). 180,000 ÷ 9 = ₱20,000 per slice. Ito ang magic number.

hint_ladder.title: Pinakamalaking Bahagi
hint_ladder.text: Tumingin sa ratio, ang pinakamalaking number ay 4. Multiply the slice value (₱20,000) by 4. 20,000 × 4 = ₱80,000. Diretso na!

hint_ladder.title: Double Check Bago Submit
hint_ladder.text: Add up all shares: 2×20k=40k, 3×20k=60k, 4×20k=80k -> total 180k. Pasok! Kaya laging unahin ang per part value.

A.text: You might have chosen A because you took the smallest ratio number (2) instead of the largest (4); 2 × ₱20,000 = ₱40,000, pero hindi iyon...

B.text: You might have chosen B because you multiplied the middle ratio (3) by ₱20,000, not the highest; 3 × 20k = 60k, pero ang hinahanap ay pin...

D.text: You might have chosen D because you assumed the largest share is half the total, ignoring the ratio; 50% ng ₱180,000 is ₱90,000.

next_time_rule: Sa ratio problems: I-add ang parts, hatiin ang total para makuha ang value per part, tapos i-multiply sa hinahanap na part. 'Parts muna, per part value, tapos target part.'
deconstruct_text:
Let’s imagine the barangay scholarship committee in our barangay distributing funds. The ratio 2:3:4 means the total is cut into 2+3+4 = 9 equal slices, like slicing a bibingka into 9 pieces.

The total fund is ₱180,000, so each slice is worth ₱180,000 ÷ 9 = ₱20,000. Now, the largest share goes to the scholar with the highest ratio number, 4.

So, 4 slices × ₱20,000 = ₱80,000. The other shares (2 parts = ₱40,000, 3 parts = ₱60,000) add up to ₱180,000. Tama!

Mental Trick: Sa ratio problems, laging hanapin ang 'value per part' muna — hatiin ang total sa total parts. 'Slices muna bago bahagi' (Taglish: Slices first before sharing).
